newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close higher, bonds off highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close higher, bonds off highs.

text.p: April 15 - U.S. debt futures closed higher, but June T-bonds ended off session highs. June rallied through 107-26/32, but failed to scale resistance at 107-28/32, the two-week high. Traders are cautious about scope of market's rally. Market faces heavy schedule of economic data this week. Housing starts on Wed at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT seen falling to rate of 1.46 million units.
